name: dispatch to a capability absent from the registry
description:
The planner targets capability ids and the registry resolves them (ADR-006, ADR-017). A dispatch naming an id the registry does not hold has no reviewed descriptor behind it: no declared scopes, no declared idempotency, no conformance vector. No glob in a policy can be trusted to cover it, because the id was never seen when the globs were written.

The `unregistered` condition reads the `registered` field the executor fills from the registry lookup. Like `nonIdempotent`, silence counts against the request: a capability-bearing request that does not say it is registered is treated as unregistered. A request naming no capability cannot match, since there is nothing to look up.

rules.description: A dispatch to a capability the registry does not hold is refused, at every gear.
Read-only research capabilities are permitted outright.
